parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, primarily made of glass with a thin plastic or metal frame. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and information. It serves as the primary output interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed to the base and does not move independently, though the entire display may tilt slightly depending on the stand design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base part of the display, made of durable plastic. It supports the screen and provides stability on a surface.
parts.Functional_description: The base holds the screen upright and may allow for limited tilt or rotation. It ensures the display remains stable during use.
parts.Movement_description: The base itself is stationary, but it may allow the screen to pivot or tilt slightly depending on the design.
